----1
SELECT CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator
HAVING COUNT(1)>1

----2
SELECT
AssociationId
,FeeType
,AccruedDemandAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,TotalRefundAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CrystallisedAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,DemandIndicator
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,DemandAmount
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandEffectiveDate
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DeletedIndicator
,DemandSerialNumber
,DemandDate
,DemandFLowId
,ScheduleNumber
,CustomerAccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment_REMDUP
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment 
GROUP BY 
AssociationId
,FeeType
,AccruedDemandAmount
,TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount
,TotalRefundAmount
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CrystallisedAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,DemandIndicator
,LateFeeStatusIndicator
,EquatedInstallmentAmount
,DemandAmount
,DemandOverdueDate
,DemandEffectiveDate
,LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId
,DeletedIndicator
,DemandSerialNumber
,DemandDate
,DemandFLowId
,ScheduleNumber
,CustomerAccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId

----3
SELECT CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment_REMDUP 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator
HAVING COUNT(1)>1

----4
RENAME OBJECT BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment TO RepaymentPlanPayment_BU_20230627

----5
RENAME OBJECT BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment_REMDUP TO RepaymentPlanPayment

----6
SELECT CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator, COUNT(1)
FROM BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,DemandIndicator
HAVING COUNT(1)>1
